title: Bot GitHub identity with least-privilege access
summary: Create a dedicated GitHub machine user for the Bot VM with a fine-grained personal access token scoped to this repository only, so Bot PRs are distinguishable from the Owner and cannot bypass CODEOWNERS review. AUTH #002 (account) is pending.

acceptance_tests.test: A machine user exists (suggested `gj-bots`) and is a collaborator with Write on this repository only.
Its fine-grained PAT grants exactly: Contents RW, Pull requests RW, Issues RW, Metadata R; no Administration, Secrets, Actions, Workflows, or Environments permissions; expiry ≤ 90 days.
The token is stored only in the Bot credential store and `~/projects/gigantic-journeys/.env.local` as `GITHUB_TOKEN`; it never appears in the repo.
acceptance_tests.evidence: secret-scan green; Foreman confirmation in qa/vm-setup/foreman.md

acceptance_tests.test: A test PR opened from the VM shows the machine user as author and cannot approve itself or merge.
Rotation date recorded in governance/AUTHORIZATION_LOG.md next to AUTH #002.

auth_required.what: GitHub machine user + fine-grained PAT scoped to this repo
